target.title: fix(polls): reject polls with fewer than two options
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where plugin poll actions with fewer than two options could receive a `maxSelections` value greater than the number of available options. The helper returned `2` for zero- and one-option multiselect polls, allowing an impossible poll state to travel farther into channel delivery.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared public SDK helper now enforces the same minimum-two-options invariant as `normalizePollInput`. Invalid polls fail immediately with the established `Poll requires at least 2 options` error; valid single-select and multiselect behavior is unchanged.

## User Impact

Plugin authors and bundled Discord/Telegram poll actions now get one consistent, actionable error for invalid option counts instead of an invalid selection limit. Polls with two or more options behave exactly as before.

## Compatibility Evidence

`resolvePollMaxSelections` was introduced on 2026-07-16 in `16c14e5bbfc9e3a82203272ec7bb82b586df0a84`. No version tag (`v*`) contains that commit; the latest shipped tag is `v2026.7.1`, which predates the helper. The invalid-input return behavior is therefore not a shipped public SDK contract.

Final-head callers were checked:

- Core outbound already rejects fewer than two poll options before calling the helper.
- Discord and Telegram action runtimes pass their parsed answer-array lengths directly; rejecting 0/1 there gives the same minimum-two-options contract as `normalizePollInput` instead of sending an impossible poll.
- The SDK export has no public documentation promising permissive behavior for invalid option counts.

## Evidence

Exact PR head `965b73d948c6c3628cacf2991104c06c9518d440`, importing the public SDK helper from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-actions`:

```text
0/true: error=Poll requires at least 2 options
1/true: error=Poll requires at least 2 options
0/false: error=Poll requires at least 2 options
1/false: error=Poll requires at least 2 options
2/true: result=2
5/true: result=5
5/false: result=1
exact_head=965b73d948c6c3628cacf2991104c06c9518d440
```

Focused regression test:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/polls.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       11 passed (11)
```

Additional checks:

```text
$ ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/polls.ts src/polls.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

$ git diff --check
# no output
```

Fresh autoreview was attempted before commit, but the engine failed before producing findings because the Responses WebSocket returned HTTP 403. No autoreview-clean claim is made.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the public SDK export, core outbound caller, and bundled Discord and Telegram callers, and I understand the contract change.
